page.title: Ku tallafa wa MyPhonicsBooks
page.heading: Komai kyauta ne. Tallafi zaɓi ne.
page.intro: Ƙaramar ƙungiya ɗaya ce ta gina MyPhonicsBooks. Idan yana taimaka wa yaronku karatu, godiya kowace iri ce za ta sa ya ci gaba da zama kyauta ga iyali na gaba.

free.books: Duk littattafan labari 33, matakai takwas — ku karanta a yanar gizo, ba sai kuna da asusu ba
free.games: Kowane wasan phonics, kyauta ne a yi
free.pdfs: PDF masu bugawa na kowane littafi da takardar aiki — kyauta tare da asusun kyauta
free.check: Gwajin phonics na minti 3 da bin diddigin cigaba

page.downloadsNote: Saukewa na buƙatar asusun kyauta domin mu tanadi PDF masu bugawa don iyalai da ajujuwa — ba don sake sayarwa ba ne.
page.cardSubtitle: Ku biya abin da kuke so · sau ɗaya · babu biyan wata-wata
page.alreadySupported: Mun gode — kun riga kun tallafa mana.
page.customAria: Adadin tallafin da kuka zaɓa a fam
page.stripeNote: Biyan kati mai tsaro ta Stripe. Ba a buɗe ko kulle komai saboda wannan ba — godiya ce, ba kuɗin sabis ba.
page.createBookNote: Kuna neman littafi na musamman? <link>Ƙirƙiri Littafi</link> £4.99 ne, kuma World of Books £10 ne sau ɗaya.

prompt.title: Kun shigo — komai kyauta ne
prompt.body: Kowane littafi, wasa da takardar aiki naku ne ba tare da biya ba. Idan MyPhonicsBooks yana taimaka wa yaronku, za ku iya bar ƙaramar godiya don ya ci gaba da zama kyauta ga sauran iyalai. Gaba ɗaya zaɓinku ne.
prompt.maybeLater: Watakila daga baya — kai ni wurin littattafai
